name: Back When
source:
You're home alone when you hear a knock at the door. Turns out it's an old friend, one you haven't seen in... a long time. One you never expected to see again.

[From [url=https://midge-the-tree.itch.io/back-when]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你听到敲门声时，你独自一人在家。原来这是一位老朋友，你已经……很久没见面了。一个你从未想过会再次见到的人。

[来自[url=https://midge-the-tree.itch.io/back-when]Itch.io[/url]]
